parameters.query:
SELECT c.id AS customer_id, c.name, c.email, c.language,
       (SELECT string_agg(w.brand || ' ' || COALESCE(w.model, '') || ' ' || w.reference, ', ')
          FROM purchases p JOIN watches w ON w.id = p.watch_id
         WHERE p.customer_id = c.id) AS past_purchases,
       (SELECT string_agg(ci.brand || COALESCE(' ' || ci.reference, ''), ', ')
          FROM customer_interests ci WHERE ci.customer_id = c.id) AS interests,
       (SELECT json_agg(s) FROM (
            SELECT w.id AS watch_id, w.brand, w.model, w.reference, w.year, w.condition, w.ask_usd AS price_usd
            FROM watches w
            WHERE w.status = 'in_stock' AND w.listings_done
              AND w.auth_status IN ('ai_checked', 'watchmaker_verified')
            ORDER BY (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM customer_interests ci
                              WHERE ci.customer_id = c.id AND lower(ci.brand) = lower(w.brand))) DESC,
                     w.created_at DESC
            LIMIT 3) s) AS suggestions,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'business_name') AS business_name,
       (SELECT value FROM settings WHERE key = 'from_email') AS from_email
FROM customers c
WHERE c.marketing_opt_in
  AND GREATEST(c.last_contact_at, c.last_purchase_at, c.created_at)
      < now() - setting_num('inactive_days') * INTERVAL '1 day'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages_log m
                  WHERE m.customer_id = c.id AND m.campaign = 'reengagement'
                    AND m.created_at > now() - INTERVAL '90 days')
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM messages_log m
                  WHERE m.customer_id = c.id AND m.campaign = 'interest_campaign'
                    AND m.created_at > now() - setting_num('campaign_cooldown_days') * INTERVAL '1 day')
LIMIT 200;

INSERT INTO messages_log (customer_id, campaign, subject)
VALUES ($1::INT, 'reengagement', $2);

parameters.content:
## Re-engage inactive customers
Once a month, opted-in customers with no contact or purchase for `inactive_days` (default 180) get a personal email about their past watch and 3 suggestions. Max once every 90 days per customer.
